bookedClasses.description: Decisions 322, 332. What to do with this slot's upcoming Classes that already have bookings, when the change moves them (day, start or end time, branch), switches the slot off, or changes their booking rules (waiver, membership inclusion, cut-offs, cancellation charge). MOVE: they follow the change and booked Students are told (not with status OFF). CANCEL: their bookings are cancelled with credit back and the Classes archived; Students are told. KEEP: they keep their day, time, place and rules. CANCEL is only for a move or switching off. Required when such Classes exist; without it the update is refused with 409. Also confirms a capacity cut below the seats booked: Classes fuller than the new capacity keep their size. Title, description, picture, coach and styles always reach every upcoming Class. Unbooked upcoming Classes always follow the change.

classId.description: Required when audience is CLASS — must be a Class of this School.

broadcastId.description: Correlates every Notification this call fanned out — used as the shared prefix of each one's notificationId/jobId.

recipientCount.description: How many distinct Students this broadcast was enqueued for.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null if this is the last page.

amount.description: Minor-unit (e.g. cents). Omit to refund the full remaining unrefunded balance.

categoryId.description: One of this School's lesson categories (Decisions 128.15, 191); the lesson goes to the end of it.

instructorId.description: A User holding an active INSTRUCTOR RoleGrant at this School — validated the same way Class.instructorId is (TenantAuthorizationService.assertValidInstructor), not a separate Instructor-profile FK.

skillIds.description: Skill ids this Lesson teaches — must all belong to this School.

free.description: Watchable by every student and guardian at the School, membership or not (Decision 190). School owner only.

order.description: Its place within its category, from 0.

free.description: Watchable by every student and guardian at the School (Decision 190).

locked.description: The caller may not watch it (Decision 195): no membership of theirs covers it. Its description and video are left out.

videoRef.description: Vendor-agnostic pointer (Decision 101: Cloudflare Stream) — null until the video-hosting pipeline exists.

playbackUrl.description: The public HLS manifest URL (Decision 227/254), computed server-side via CloudflareStreamService.getPublicPlaybackUrl — null unless captionStatus is READY and the Lesson is unlocked. Not yet verified against a real Cloudflare Stream account (see that method's own header comment).

commentCount.description: Comments on this lesson the caller can read (Decision 326).

archivedAt.description: Decision 226 — set when this Lesson has been archived. Null when active. Coexists with Decision 198's own DELETE /lessons/{id} (always allowed) as a reversible alternative.

purgeAt.description: Decision 226 — 90 days after archivedAt; the scheduled purge sweep hard-deletes this Lesson once this elapses.

purgedAt.description: Decision 226 — set by the purge sweep once actually purged.

categoryId.description: Move it to another of this School's categories (to the end), or null for none.

free.description: Watchable by every student and guardian at the School, membership or not (Decision 190). School owner only.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, ordered (createdAt, id) DESC; null when there is no more.

completed.description: Set true once playback reaches the end. Never used to clear a prior completion.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, ordered (updatedAt, id) DESC; null when there is no more.
Opaque cursor for the next page, ordered (createdAt, id) DESC; null when there is no more.

available.description: False when the caller can no longer see this Lesson (it was archived, or they left its School); lessonTitle is then empty and the item can only be removed.

locked.description: The caller may not watch this Lesson (Decisions 154, 190, 195).

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, ordered (createdAt, id) ASC (oldest first); null when there is no more.

screen.description: The app screen this label belongs to (e.g. "login", "academyDetail").

labelKey.description: The label key within that screen (e.g. "welcomeMessage").

locale.description: Free text — no canonical language code list is confirmed yet (domain-rules §1).

content.description: The translated text for this screen/labelKey/locale.

schoolId.description: Required for entityType INSTRUCTOR/BRANCH/CLASS, and for USER when acting on behalf of a Student.

franchiseId.description: For entityType FRANCHISE editing an EXISTING Franchise, this is required and must equal entityId. Omit both when creating a brand-new Franchise (mirrors POST /franchises itself, which needs no prior RoleGrant either).

entityId.description: The existing Instructor/Branch/Class/Franchise row's own id, or the target Student's User id for entityType USER on-behalf-of. Omit when creating a brand-new entity (its id does not exist yet) or editing your own User row.

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL, valid for 5 minutes — upload the photo file directly here, with the exact Content-Type this endpoint was called with.

publicUrl.description: The permanent, public URL to save onto the entity's photoUrl/logoUrl/bannerUrl/profilePhotoUrl field once the upload succeeds. Never expires or needs re-signing.
